basis: The deployed WM contract now includes native launch visibility, shell chrome/transient policy, output capture, workspace controls, agent affordances, recovery operations, and soak evidence.
Wayfire is already installed and passes the deployed auto-tiling, popup, overlay, responsiveness, multi-output route, and live-session soak harnesses.
Smithay remains attractive for Rust-owned compositor authority but has no agora-de runtime proof for native clients, launch mapping, capture, shell chrome, or deployment operations.

contractRequirements.requiredBehavior: Report mode, settings, revision, workspace/zone state, surface order, focus order, participation, policyClass, and acknowledged geometry.
contractRequirements.wayfireEvidence: Installed /api/layout and compositorctl layout get are exercised by check-auto-tiling-wm and check-live-session-soak.
contractRequirements.smithayEvidence: Fixture-only; no running Smithay backend emits this contract for native clients.

contractRequirements.requiredBehavior: Apply setMode, assignZone, tile, moveResize, setFloating, focus/promote, state changes, close, and workspace activation with classified command results.
contractRequirements.wayfireEvidence: Wayfire bridge/plugin handles commands through /api/layout/action, /api/surfaces/action, and agora-de-compositorctl.
contractRequirements.smithayEvidence: Conceptually straightforward because a Smithay compositor could own configure/placement, but not implemented.

contractRequirements.requiredBehavior: Map structured desktop-entry launch completion to trusted compositor surface ids, mapped/focused state, cleanup, and reuse classifications.
contractRequirements.wayfireEvidence: Installed native launch harnesses prove launch status and surface visibility against Wayfire.
contractRequirements.smithayEvidence: Missing; no Smithay socket launch path or launchlife integration exists.

contractRequirements.requiredBehavior: Keep panel, background, overlay, launcher/status popups, dialogs, menus, and unmanaged helpers out of deterministic tiling with explicit policy metadata.
contractRequirements.wayfireEvidence: Layer-shell chrome and policyClass surfaces are visible in /api/surfaces, /api/layout, and popup stability evidence.
contractRequirements.smithayEvidence: Design-compatible but not proven with layer-shell shell surfaces.

contractRequirements.requiredBehavior: Produce output capture artifacts with visible classification and expected shell/native pixels.
contractRequirements.wayfireEvidence: Installed Wayfire output capture produces capture_visible evidence for WM and soak harnesses.
contractRequirements.smithayEvidence: Missing; no capture path or live artifact exists.

contractRequirements.requiredBehavior: Expose structured state/actions and overlay labels stable enough for coding agents to use without screenshot inference.
contractRequirements.wayfireEvidence: compositorctl, /api/layout, /api/surfaces, /api/workspaces, and overlay labels are available in the installed session.
contractRequirements.smithayEvidence: Backend-neutral contract can be reused, but no Smithay adapter or overlay proof exists.

contractRequirements.requiredBehavior: Install, update, restart, recover, kill stale clients, and run live soak without VMs or agora-os dependency.
contractRequirements.wayfireEvidence: Existing den-k8 service scripts and recovery helpers are documented and tested.
contractRequirements.smithayEvidence: Missing; no nested or installed service path exists.

wayfireResponsibilityMap.responsibility: Wayfire plugin socket and compositor-control socket
wayfireResponsibilityMap.backendNeutralOwner: Go bridge until replaced by generated Rust/backend transport

wayfireResponsibilityMap.responsibility: Surface lifecycle, focus, visibility, geometry, workspace, and output events
Layout mode, rule settings, zone assignment, surface order, focus order, revisions, and classified command results
wayfireResponsibilityMap.backendNeutralOwner: Rust layout model and compositor-backend-api contract

wayfireResponsibilityMap.responsibility: Master-stack, zones, gaps, ratios, future dwindle/columns, and layout selection
Shell chrome, theme, launcher, taskbar, overlay presentation, and status UI
Input denial and transient/dialog tiling exclusion

wayfireResponsibilityMap.backendNeutralOwner: backend capture adapter plus live harness classifier

reopenTriggers: Wayfire layout actions require synthetic keyboard shortcuts.
Wayfire geometry or focus must be inferred from shell state, browser rectangles, screenshots, or capture pixels.
Wayfire plugin scope grows into shell UI, launcher, theme, governance, or layout heuristics.
A future layout rule cannot be represented as Rust planner output plus backend acknowledgement.

A nested Smithay proof hosts two native clients, maps governed launch to surface ids, applies the shared layout command fixture, reports workspace/focus/order state, and produces capture-visible evidence with lower backend complexity than Wayfire.
